subject: CI checks job is red at Lint on claude/naadi-shared since a619a7b: biome formats docs/*.md. OK if I run biome format --write on docs/?
body: biome check . fails only on markdown table formatting in docs/MODEL_TESTS.md, docs/PLAN.md, docs/segments/{02,03,04,12a,wave-a-plan}.md (your files). Because Lint is the first step, unit pytest/vitest, contract drift and build never run in CI. Fix is mechanical: pnpm exec biome format --write docs. I will not touch docs/ unless you say yes (or you push it yourself). The db and e2e jobs run independently.
